title: Declare SpectrumVisualizer header and ring buffer
description:
Create Source/GUI/SpectrumVisualizer.h only. Declare a juce::Component subclass SpectrumVisualizer that consumes FFT magnitude frames from a lock-free juce::AbstractFifo / SPSC ring buffer on a juce::Timer (message thread only). It must never run on the audio thread and must never allocate in any path that could be audio-called.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY Source/GUI/SpectrumVisualizer.h.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/PluginProcessor.h
- Source/PluginProcessor.cpp
- Source/GUI/ (existing GUI headers)
- any FIFO / FFT size constants declared in phase e for the processor push side

Header requirements:
- Class SpectrumVisualizer : public juce::Component, private juce::Timer
- Public API enough for the editor to host it (constructor/destructor, paint, resized as needed)
- Push/consume API that only reads frames the processor already pushed into the SPSC FIFO (no direct audio-thread coupling)
- juce::dsp::FFT size and AbstractFifo / ring capacity constants must match the processor buffer sizes from phase e (do not invent divergent FFT sizes)
- Timer interval intended for ~30 Hz (state the Hz constant in the header)
- No heap allocation in documented audio-path surfaces; all audio-thread interaction is processor-side push into the lock-free FIFO only
- Include guards / #pragma once and minimal JUCE includes
- Method and member declarations only; no out-of-line implementations in this task

Do not implement .cpp, MeterComponent, PluginEditor, or PluginProcessor in this task.
acceptance_criteria: Source/GUI/SpectrumVisualizer.h declares class SpectrumVisualizer deriving from juce::Component and juce::Timer
Source/GUI/SpectrumVisualizer.h declares juce::AbstractFifo (or equivalent SPSC ring) members and FFT size constants aligned with the processor FIFO from phase e
Source/GUI/SpectrumVisualizer.h documents or declares a ~30 Hz timer cadence
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: call repaint() from any audio-thread API

allowed: declare AbstractFifo ring buffer and FFT size constants matching processor phase e
declare Timer-driven consume path on the message thread
forbidden: change processor DSP or FIFO push logic
introduce a non-lock-free UI transfer path
